reason: ContextualLoggerMiddleware dereferences req.PluginContext without nil checks in QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth, and CollectMetrics (pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go:39-57), whereas LoggerMiddleware and other middlewares guard against nil req (pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:63,77,90,104). Impact is limited because client.Decorator rejects nil requests before running middlewares (pkg/plugins/manager/client/decorator.go:25-60), so this only panics if ContextualLoggerMiddleware is invoked directly outside Decorator.
